title: M2: OpenCode and Pi enrolled as official hosts — provider vocabulary (`opencode`, `pi`) through the shared engine, in-process plugin packages that append the provider ledger, ledger mappers with S0b-proven token semantics (OpenCode adds cache and reasoning back, Pi adds cache back; inherited fork history yields no receipt), commands via OpenCode's config hook and Pi's registerCommand, install/remove/doctor/setup for both

claude.rationale: The provider vocabulary widened in shared code (session-events, provider-context, connect/align/status/end, the host loop) — the Claude branches are untouched in logic and the whole suite passes; the generated Claude command files are byte-identical (gen:workflows --check).

codex.rationale: Same shared change; the Codex hook mapper, rollout mapper and context reader are untouched and their suites pass; the generated Codex skills are byte-identical.

opencode.rationale: New host: ledger mapper (session-opencode-hooks.ts) and the in-process plugin (plugins/opencode/src/index.js) exercised against the S0b native fixtures (OpenCode 1.18.9).

pi.rationale: New host: ledger mapper (session-pi-hooks.ts) and the in-process extension (plugins/pi/src/index.js) exercised against the S0b native fixtures (Pi 0.85.1).
